base: an unaltered modern human standing upright with relaxed arms, pale muted skin and a plain grey waist wrap
extinct: the mummified, half-petrified remains of a post-human curled in darkness, with papery ash-grey skin stretched over bone and crumbling into dust
gravity_up: a short, squat, wide body with dense pillar-like legs, broad flat feet, a thick muscular neck and a barrel torso
gravity_down: a very tall, slender body with elongated light limbs, a narrow ribcage and long fragile fingers
radiation_up: a hairless body covered in thick, charcoal-grey leathery dermal armor with keratin ridges, an enlarged bony cranial dome and tiny recessed eyes behind heavy protective lids
radiation_down: very pale translucent skin, enlarged dark eyes, a thin slim body and almost no hair
temperature_up: a lean body with elongated limbs, oversized thin ears that shed heat and sleek, sparsely haired skin
temperature_down: a stocky body with thick insulating fat, dense pale fur, small ears and a broad flat face
oxygen_up: an oversized, robust frame with large strong limbs, glossy skin and a powerful ribcage
oxygen_down: an enormous barrel chest, flared nostrils, a heavy slow posture and bluish-tinged skin
water_up: a smooth, hairless, streamlined body with webbed hands and feet and gill-like slits on the neck
water_down: a wiry, lean body with thick cracked leathery skin, slit-like nostrils, deep skin folds and sunken eyes
